decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the established and well-liked BASIC 518 trommel and was publicly rebranded, so the sunk investment and visible commitment keep management attached to it, even though it was not observed on the website in 2020 to 2021.
The multi-model flail shredder line has its own page and fits the core mobile processing business, so management would attribute any weak demand to temporary market conditions such as the pandemic.

The mobile high-speed grinder line was a multi-model investment in the firm's mobile strategy, so despite low visibility management would persist and blame shortfalls on the ramp-up and pandemic disruption.
This single model has the least sunk investment and visibility, but its electric, resource-saving profile matches the announced direction, so management would justify keeping it a while longer.
The green-waste grinder line serves core composting and biomass customers with several models, so the commitment to it outweighs its limited web presence.
The stationary pre-shredder line has its own page and supports the push into tougher stationary processing, so strong commitment makes keeping it the clear choice.
